name: nuxmv-editor-js
description: Browser-based diagram editor for the nuXmv model checker: draw or type a state transition system, generate a nuXmv model, verify LTL/CTL/invariant properties and visualise counterexamples.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nuxmv-editor/language && npm run build -w @nuxmv-editor/server && npm run build -w @nuxmv-editor/app
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nuxmv-editor/language && concurrently -n server,app -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @nuxmv-editor/server" "npm start -w @nuxmv-editor/app"
scripts.test: npm test -w @nuxmv-editor/language && npm test -w @nuxmv-editor/server && npm test -w @nuxmv-editor/app -- --watch=false
